task_description: Refactor the Kouvola sports venue reservation converter from a brittle 49-line script into a production-quality Python CLI application with proper project structure, robust regex-based parsing, multiple output formats (CSV/JSON/XLSX), direct PDF support, CLI interface, unit tests, and GitHub Actions CI.

verification.summary: ruff check passes with no errors. All 24 pytest tests pass (13 parser, 6 output, 4 CLI + 1 garbage input). CLI correctly finds 114 KJP reservations from fixture data. Review feedback addressed: output write errors handled, pdf_reader cleaned up, test env preserved, sentinel constant extracted, garbage input test added.
